why_best: Proven 2023/2026 format, the '40 times at 2am' detail is painfully specific, and reposting it flatters every prompt-wrangler who feels unseen.
why_second: Strongest hook of the demo family, mechanism is checkable in one line, 'invisible to every viewer, readable to everything else' is quotable.
why_worst: LinkedIn cadence, no hook, no specific claim, nothing to argue with or check.
notes: Mashups (P12, P13) lose to their parents; blending two hooks dilutes both. 'We built' (P14) instantly reads as marketing. Cartridge metaphor works better as garnish (P7) than as the hook (P4).
